text: Figure 1.2: Abstract Working Principle of the Synchronized Time-Base Manager The Synchronized Time-Base Manager will be the interface between the Freshness Value Manager (FVM) and the <Bus>TSyn modules. Once requested, the Freshness Value is provided to the <Bus>TSyn modules, and then used to secure the Time Synchronization Messages. The FVM can either be a SW-C or a CDD.
